title: What the Pacific band played and where
summary: Love says the Pacific band mostly played Sunday society parades on the Algiers side and down the coast.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Well, back to the Pacific band, what kind of jobs would they play?
Brass band, like the rest of these, but they mostly played parades at that time. Sunday, all day Sunday parades. Every Sunday some society turned out, you know.
Would they play mostly on this side or mostly on the other side?
They used to play on the other side, but mostly this side. All down that coast down down below the Navy.

Yeah, used to walk on rocks, dirty roads. Way down far in Belichick. And on the Sunday they'd have a parade like Levy and go to Brittany and back. The next Sunday they'd go out in the night board somewhere.
